Alder: Hello, {VAR 0100 0000}.
This way.{VAR BE01}

They are living beings from whom we
humans have much to learn.{VAR BE01}

They are beings whose greatness we
should acknowledge!{VAR BE01}
Beings who should be freed
from our oppression!

Is it true?{VAR BE01}
Have we been making Pokémon suffer?{VAR BE01}

No way!{VAR BE01}
Without Pokémon, I'll be lonely and sad!{VAR BE01}

What was that about?
That speech was off-the-charts strange!{VAR BE01}
Alder: Let's go, {VAR 0100 0000}!{VAR BE01}

Alder: It's been a while, Iris
and Drayden.{VAR BE01}

Iris: Oh! Mr. Alder!
...And the guy who helped out that time.{VAR BE01}

Iris: Oh! Mr. Alder!
...And the girl who helped out that time.{VAR BE01}

Farewell.
I'm counting on you, Drayden and Iris!{VAR BE01}
Iris: That way!{VAR BE01}
Iris: Just a little farther!{VAR BE01}
Iris: This is it!{VAR BE01}

If all Pokémon are released, Trainers and
Gym Leaders will no longer exist.{VAR BE01}
For better or worse, the world
would surely change...

Even if it is inconvenient, I think
some things shouldn't be changed.

Even if you love them, I think
some things have to be changed.

I like older things better than new ones.
They're just more relaxing!

I like newer things better than old ones.
They're just so cool!

The Gym Leader Drayden is the mayor who
leads Opelucid.{VAR BE01}
He is always training by wrestling
with Pokémon.

So, have we really been making
our Pokémon suffer...?

I'll definitely keep moving forward
together with my Pokémon.{VAR BE01}
I won't take their company for granted.
I'll appreciate how amazing that is!

The legendary Pokémon is the symbol
of Unova.{VAR BE01}
Does that mean Team Plasma is right?
...I don't know.

Pursuing ideals is different from person
to person and Pokémon to Pokémon.{VAR BE01}
In this city, it seems the ideal is
to cherish the past.

Our hopes are put into this melody...
I will send them to the future.

Professor Juniper: ...Hello!
How was Iris doing?{VAR BE01}

Professor Juniper: ...Hello!
Was Drayden as tough as ever?{VAR BE01}
{VAR 0100 0000}, this is a present for you!{VAR BE01}
